name: submit_verdict
description: The trade card. Every close-watch decision — entry, hold, tighten, exit, no-trade, or abandon — ends with exactly this call. Never free text.

plan.description: Required when verdict is ENTER_LIMIT or ENTER_STOP; omitted otherwise

next_attention.description: Optional; only meaningful when verdict is WATCH or HOLD. Requests that Python wake this Demon on a specific, packet-grounded condition instead of the routine trigger cadence (scanner-attention-routing.md §8a). Never a raw timer, never a bare invented price — every condition must resolve to a level already present in this packet, and it narrows the trigger set, it never suppresses the mechanical stop, expiry, or DROP/DEMOTE checks.

level_ref.description: Must name a level already present in this packet, e.g. 'pattern_lower_boundary', 'pattern_upper_boundary', 'invalidation_condition' — never a freestanding number

release_slot.description: true: Watch-Manager DEMOTEs this candidate to LONG_WATCH now and arms the D3 pre-gate on this condition, freeing the close-watch slot. false (default): stays in CLOSE_WATCH; the condition replaces the routine cadence for this candidate only.

abandon_reason.description: Required when verdict is ABANDON; omitted otherwise
